title: HOLLOWAY is a top down adventure on a shuffled highland whose own solver proves every seed finishable before it is offered
author: CS_Asset_Factory
selftext:
HOLLOWAY is a top down adventure on a hand built highland: a sword, four tools and three barrows. Every new game reshuffles which chest holds which tool or key and which barrow sits behind which mouth. Before a seed is offered, the game's own solver plays it through and proves it finishable, and every one way drop leads back toward the central Sward, so no order of play can lock you out. Three bosses each draw their one attack on the floor before it lands.

Made with AI assistance end to end: code, pixel art, text and the test harness that plays it to the ending. Disclosed on the page. Free demo in the browser; the full game is a Windows download for $7.99.

https://csaf.itch.io/holloway
